evidence: Workbook row 41 requires binary pass/fail behavior and anchored Likert craft. Its internal binary/weighted annotation is explicitly qualified by the frozen skill (SKILL.md:65 and quality-checks.md:168-170). Manual criterion review and a TOML parse found 2 binary gate criteria, 86 binary Functional criteria, 14 binary Polish criteria and 6 Likert Visual criteria with points=5. Functional tests specify observable identities, amounts, transitions, refusal, or persistence; for example task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:132-139 grades populated compensation information rather than layout, and :213-220 grades exact intrinsic arithmetic. Polish is also operational: task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:36-42 excludes aesthetic composition from mobile operability; :81-87 accepts a saved record as success feedback and requires an identifiable error without prescribed toast, wording or color. Its prompt.md:8 excludes subjective visual craft. All six Visual blocks (task/tests/scored/visual/judge.toml:17-105) use Likert and describe every integer anchor 1,2,3,4,5; their subjects are typography, palette/contrast, spacing, hierarchy, component consistency and responsive composition. A scripted anchor check confirmed all 30 anchors. Current NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:160,239 explicitly corrects the starter extra-zero scale to raw 1-5; therefore the unchanged starter extra anchor is not a missing-anchor defect here. The hash-verified configured visual prompt at local/configured-inspection/scored-visual-resolved.md:34-75 contains the same anchors and generated integer-from-1-to-5 hints (SHA256 7b2dc648cb54e972fa392a21e15d9e3c30293a98012060856f992766f2ea6e5e). Adversarial source reasoning: a beautiful app using gross equity value still fails the binary intrinsic outcome; an operational app with repeated component mismatches receives the explicit Visual 3 anchor rather than full binary craft credit. A conforming alternative using native controls, stacked/scrollable compensation details and saved-record feedback is permitted by the behavioral descriptions and can receive graduated appearance credit. No concrete type/anchor mismatch found. Verified all 17 cited frozen/policy source hashes against the manifest and the configured visual artifact against the current evidence index, whose input hash matches this review. This is a bounded source/type/anchor review; no paid aesthetic judgement or full configured judge run was performed or inferred.
